author: claude
summary: Mandatory adversarial review fixes for the voices-variants-round2 plan (post tasks 001-010): fixed MultiSelect's dead keyboard navigation and invalid nested-button chip markup, and restored variant renaming (lost when task 009 folded ScriptEditor into VariantEditor without wiring variantName/onVariantNameChange).

files.change: Trigger changed from <button> to a focusable role=combobox <div> (tabIndex 0) so keyboard nav (Arrow/Enter/Space/Escape) works while focus stays on the trigger -- the listbox panel never received focus, so its onKeyDown was dead. Chip 'Remove' controls changed from <span role=button> nested inside the old trigger <button> (invalid markup, not tabbable) to real sibling <button> elements, independently reachable via Tab.

Rewrote for the new combobox role; added tests proving Tab reaches each chip's remove button and Enter/Space activates it, and that ArrowDown+Enter from the keyboard actually toggles an option's value (not just that a handler exists).

Wired variantName/onVariantNameChange into the inline ScriptEditor, reproducing the retired TestTab's default-vs-non-default routing: default variant profiles POST to /api/speaker-profiles/{name}/variant-name, non-default profiles POST to /api/speaker-profiles/{name}/rename -- both endpoints confirmed still live in app/api/routers/.
Fixed a stale comment claiming VariantEditor doesn't offer variant renaming.
Added 4 tests: field renders prefilled, non-default variant renames via /rename, default variant renames via /variant-name (never /rename), unchanged name makes no rename call.
Updated 6 queries for MultiSelect's button-to-combobox role change (the CLASS/GENDER/AGE/tag catalog filters are MultiSelects).

flow_impact: Closes out the voices-variants-round2 plan (~/.claude/plans/audiobook-factory/voices-variants-round2/, now archiving). Full frontend suite green: 2226/2226 across 266 files, tsc clean.
